releases.title: 首页合并为加速
body: 首页合并为"加速"：上方是可拖动的时光机，下方是精选，拖回过去就看那天；"全部"改为信息流上的"精选 / 全部"切换。

en.title: An Acceleration front page
body: The front page is now Acceleration: a draggable time machine above the picks. Drag into the past to read that day’s picks. All moves into a Picks / All switch on the feed.

releases.title: 网站上线
body: 用开源资讯框架搭起了这个站：自动盯住信源、精选、把同一件事归到一起，每天早上出一份日报。
这是示例条目。新条目写在 site/changelog.json 的最前面，并把 latestVersion 改成它的日期和时间，导航上就会出现提醒红点。

en.title: Website launch
body: Built with an open-source news framework, this site monitors sources, selects noteworthy stories, groups reports about the same event, and publishes a daily briefing every morning.
This is a sample entry. Add new entries at the top of site/changelog.json and set latestVersion to the new entry’s date and time to show a notification dot in the navigation.
